_comment: Cosmetics (Garage design, Decisions, 'Cosmetics'; T-552): the jump effects the player unlocks with coins and picks in the Cosmetics menu. Price 0 = free and unlocked from the start. No texts here: names come from T-550's data. Prices are proposals for the playtest: a run earns about 250 coins and the cheapest garage upgrade level costs 40, so the effects cost about 0.6, 1.2, 1.8 and 2.4 runs of coins.
